## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

- **PR #**: 1273
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1273
- **Title**: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +90
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T09:37:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

- **Title**: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -6

- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

# Pull Request Information

- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1273
- **Title**: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +90
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T09:37:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).

# pr-1273: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)

## Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1273
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1273
- **Title**: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +90
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T09:37:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs

  = deny).

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

```dart
Future<void> waitFor(bool Function() done, {int maxTicks = 40}) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < maxTicks && !done(); i++) {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 150));

Not blocking — the inline loop matches the existing local style; just worth consolidating while the pattern keeps accruing copies.

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `isNot(contains('\r'))` may false-positive on CRLF checkouts**

The guard assumes the source file's line breaks never carry `\r`. If a contributor checks the repo out with `core.autocrlf=true` (Windows), the multiline raw string's own line endings could contain `\r` (depending on how the toolchain normalizes source line endings), making this assertion fail for reasons unrelated to the regression it guards. Two cheap hardenings, either is fine:

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

- **Title**: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -6

- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -6

- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

The guard assumes the source file's line breaks never carry `\r`. # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

- **Title**: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -6

- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it

## Project layout

  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1273
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1273
- **Title**: gh-1272 [BUG] [URGENT] 1.0.512 TestFlight (build 205): EVERY JS widget dead — engine eval error 'Unterminated regular expression literal /[ ⇥' on all widgets (source corruption in assembly/catalog path)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1272` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +90
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T09:37:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:21:53Z

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.

This introduces a third copy of the `for (var i = 0; i < N && ...; i++) { await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 150)); }` polling pattern (the file already has one at ~line 387 and `waitForExport` at ~line 1998). Consider extracting a small helper, e.g.:

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

## PR Description

## gh-1272 — every JS widget dead: `Unterminated regular expression literal '/[ ⇥'`

### Root Cause
- The shared host bootstrap `_faBootstrapJs` in `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart` was declared as a **non-raw** Dart string (`'''`). The gh-1164 fingerprint block inside it embeds JS regex char classes (`/[ \t\r\n]+/g`) and `'\n'` string literals; Dart's escape processing converted those to **real TAB/CR/LF at compile time**.
- The runtime concatenates the bootstrap verbatim into the script handed to the JS engine (no re-escape anywhere in source → store → load → eval), so every widget eval hit a real newline inside a regex literal — byte-identical failure for all widgets, exactly matching the TestFlight log. This is also the root of gh-1266's red js-apps cluster (81 `test/apps` failures on the broken tree).
- The file was additionally corrupt at rest in the same block (lines 1027/1040): the whitespace-collapse replacement string lost its space and closing quote (`' '` → `'`).

### Fix
- `js_app_engine.dart`: `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`, no `$` interpolation inside) so `\t`/`\r`/`\n` reach the JS engine byte-identically; restored the corrupted `' '` replacement on both fingerprint-normalizer lines.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: real QuickJS engine boot of a regex-heavy widget (`/[ \t\n]+/` char class) failed with the ticket's signature (`uiTree set: false`); after the fix it evals and renders, asserting the regex matches byte-identically (gh-1272 NG2 fixture).
- New pure-Dart regression test asserts the bootstrap keeps escape sequences byte-identical and leaks no real TAB/CR (catches any future non-raw reintroduction).
- `test/apps`: **519 passed** (was 441 passed / 81 failed before the fix). The 3 remaining failures (2× `js_app_error_capture`, 1× `open_app_tool`) fail **identically on the pristine tree** — pre-existing Linux-bridge artifacts (`{id: …}` console wrapping breaks the `faAppError:` JSON parse; a binding-init issue), not regressions.
- `flutter analyze` clean; `dart format` applied; bridge-parity suite green (70 tests).

### Notes
- gh-1266 cross-check: same root — the fixed tree turns its whole red cluster green; the two issues should close together (AC3).
- NG1 (release-blocking catalog-fetched widget smoke leg) and NG3 (wire gh-1267 N3) are CI/infra workstreams not covered by this code fix; the regression tests here are the deterministic per-PR guard in the meantime.
